items.question: m Excuse me, when will our food be ready? Ek
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“m Excuse me, when will our food be ready? Ek”，自然应答是“The kitchen is really busy.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（The kitchen is really busy.）。
